newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill- private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill- private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday on Monday were at a standstill following last week's brisk activity, livestock sources said.
The active sales last week at $105.00 to $106.00 per cwt on a dressed basis have packers well supplied with live cattle inventories for the start of this week, they said.
Owners were pricing cattle at $107.00/dressed and $67.00/live, but were not finding bids, the sources said.
This week's showlist was estimated near 80,000 head, down about 13,000 from last week.
